tiles: All custom artwork drawn by hand for client
Logo and brand elements reflect personal teaching style
No AI content maintains authentic human touch
Webflow platform enables client content management
challenge: Wellness professionals need websites that genuinely reflect their personal approach and build trust with potential clients. Generic templates fall short in an industry where personality and authenticity drive client relationships. This project required developing a complete visual identity from scratch, including logo, brand elements, and background artwork, all grounded in the client's unique teaching philosophy and personal energy.
approach: Collaborated closely with the client to understand their teaching methodology, values, and vision for their online presence. Hand-drew all brand elements using iPad Pro and Apple Pencil, including custom logo, background illustrations, and decorative details, to create a cohesive visual identity expressing the client's personality and wellness philosophy. Built the Webflow platform to showcase training programs while enabling independent content management. The deliberate choice to hand-draw every element maintained the authentic human touch essential to wellness industry credibility.
result: Delivered a distinctive visual brand identity that differentiates the client in a crowded wellness market. The hand-drawn elements create warmth and personality impossible to achieve with stock imagery or AI-generated graphics. The Webflow platform empowers the client to maintain their site independently while preserving the custom design integrity. The project demonstrates end-to-end brand development alongside website design, a core capability for freelance and agency engagements.
